title: What Scripture Actually Says About Being Hard on Yourself (It's Not Shame)
caption:
Scripture never asked you to hate yourself. It asked you to kill the sin.

Conviction names the deed. Shame names the man. Be ruthless with one, gentle with the other, and give your brothers the same.

Which one do you do backwards?

#faith #scripture #romans8 #godlymen #christianman #grace
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
